extraAssets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent game OBJECT SPRITE ATLAS for the attached approved isometric children's game. Match its bright faceted stylized 3D, warm polished forms, clear recognizable object silhouettes. Each fits within central 76% of its cell, padding, no overlap, no shadows outside object, no borders, no labels, no text. Order LEFT TO RIGHT then TOP TO BOTTOM: row 1: bowl of vegetable soup; red apple with leaf; yellow banana; orange carrot; white rabbit; gray cat. Row 2: red gift box yellow ribbon; purple balloon; yellow crescent moon; leafy green tree; red roof house; mallard duck. Row 3: golden key; blue notebook; blue pencil case with pencils; white and blue eraser; handheld pink mirror; single brown date fruit with palm leaflet. Row 4: braided golden challah bread; glass of milk; turquoise ocean wave; green mountain; yellow lightning bolt; pink flower. Row 5: friendly green crocodile; proud rooster; little blue train; traffic light; cute lion; gray elephant. Row 6: red heart; gold star; fluffy cloud; small rain cloud with raindrops; small rainbow; friendly brown mouse. All 36 distinct objects, consistent size, neutral front/three quarter view, no Hebrew or any writing, no human faces. Transparent canvas between objects. This will be used as CSS sprites sliced by exact 1/6 grid, so exact equal rows and columns and centering are critical.
